page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with a running head at the top: page number left, running title "HISTORIA" right. No margin notes, no footnotes. The Google watermark at the bottom right is a digitiser's mark and is left out.

main_text.p: minis Deo dicatis, & sacrum propositum transgredientibus, & de revocatione, & de pœnitentia eorum.

Nonus liber continet de virginibus & viduis non velatis, de raptoribus earum, & de separatione eorum, de conjunctione legitimorum connubiorum, de concubinis, & de transgressione & pœnitentia singulorum.

Decimus liber continet de incantatoribus, de auguribus, de divinis, de sortilegis, & de variis illusionibus Diaboli, & de maleficis, & de contentiosis, & de conspiratoribus, & de pœnitentia singulorum.
Undecimus liber continet de excommunicandis, & excommunicatis, de furibus, & de prædatoribus, & de præsumptione, & contemptu, & negligentia, & reconciliatione & pœnitentia eorum.
Duodecimus liber continet de perjurio, & de pœnitentia ejus.
Tertiusdecimus liber continet de veneratione, & observatione sacri jejunii.
Quartusdecimus liber continet de crapula, & ebrietate, & de pœnitentia eorum.
Quintusdecimus liber continet de Imperatoribus, de Principibus, & de reliquis laicis, & de ministerio eorum.
Sextusdecimus liber continet de accusatoribus, de judicibus, de defensoribus, de falsis

page.notes: Catchword "falsis" appears at the right below the last line; it is the start of the next line and is given in the text above. Several specks and stains on the scan were ignored. The reading "falsis" at the foot is partly unclear and marked accordingly in the text as printed.
